title: serving-sprint-launchpad-arun-personal-draft
content:
Purpose / tone: quick weekly sync that is engineering-heavy but friendly — keep to 35m. Aim: unblock work for the week, call out 1 deep-dive topic (20m), 2 lightning updates (5m), and action-driven close (10m). This is my personal prep; copy for meeting notes and link to final agenda after.

Logistics
- Timebox: 35 minutes (Start on the 5, end by :40)
- Invitees: serving-runtime core, infra-liaisons, console representative (small), SRE on rotation
- Pre-reads (send in thread 24h before): latest p95 latency chart, canary summary, INF-4321 repro steps
- Slack channel for live notes: #serving-ops

Quick agenda (35m)
1) Quick sync (5m)
  - Round-robin: one-sentence blockers / major wins
  - Metrics to call out: p95 end-to-end latency (last 24h), pod CPU avg, error-rate (5xx) trend
2) Deep-dive (20m) — 'cache TTL and prefix-sharing impact'
  - Why: small regression after last kernel swap; hypothesis that prefix eviction pattern changed
  - Goal: agree on an experiment to run this week (A/B TTL 60s vs 300s) and owner/infra plan
  - Pre-reads: kernel-swap notes (PR#987) and local repro logs attached
3) Lightning updates (5m)
  - Dedicated infra: capacity bump schedule for cluster alpha
  - Console: a quick note on rollout UI change that touches canary toggles
4) Action review & parking lot (5m)
  - Confirm owners + due dates
  - Parking lot items (deferred)

My bullets to hit in meeting
- Status: cluster alpha steady; 2% token/sec drop on long sequences after kernel swap
- Hypothesis: eviction + KV cache invalidation on chunked requests -> larger tail latency
- Need infra window for an experiment (2-3 hours low-traffic) — propose Thu 09:30-12:00 UTC
- Console change: disable auto-rollback during manual canary run (Rachel has patch)

Deep-dive prep (notes to self)
- Repro steps: run long-seq load with prefix reuse; compare KV cache hit rate (local env)
- Data to bring: per-pod KV hit rates, p99 assembly time, GC pauses, kernel swap PR notes
- Experiment plan draft:
  - A variant A: TTL 60s (current production)
  - Variant B: TTL 300s with conservative memory cap
  - Measure: p95, p99, KV hit rate, memory usage, error-rate
  - Success threshold: p95 within 5% of baseline AND memory delta < 8% per pod
- Infra ask: 2 spare g4dn nodes, temp autoscale disabled for window

Action items (explicit, copy to tracker after meeting)
- A1: Run TTL A/B experiment (create ephemeral cluster, run load harness) — owner: Diego Rivera — due: 2026-03-15
- A2: Gather per-pod KV hit metrics and attach to INF-4321 — owner: Arun Desai — due: 2026-03-13
- A3: Coordinate infra window and nukes (ensure no autoscale) — owner: Maya Chen — due: 2026-03-12
- A4: Console change to add a manual-canary toggle and documentation — owner: Rachel Li — due: 2026-03-18
- A5: Post-meeting writeup + send follow-up thread with results and next steps — owner: Arun Desai — due: 2026-03-16

Risks / unknowns (notes)
- If the experiment increases memory >8% we need a rollback plan; pre-create a snapshot of canary state
- Unknown: whether shorter TTLs hurt prefix reuse for chat-style workloads — add chat-traffic filter to experiment
- Possible dependency: model-quantization PR may change kernel paths mid-week — check with research

Parking lot (defer unless we have cycles)
- Revisit continuous batching heuristics for short-seq API traffic
- Small UX ask: console should show last successful canary commit/tag
- Longer-term: add automated canary comparison dashboard (screenshot template in confluence)

Prep checklist (for me before sending agenda)
- [ ] Export p95/p99 charts (last 72h)
- [ ] Attach INF-4321 repro logs to pre-read
- [ ] Confirm Diego + Maya can run experiment Thu morning
- [ ] Draft 1-sentence blurb for opening round-robin

Notes to self: Keep the deep-dive focused; avoid diving into unrelated infra debt. If we hit a blocker that needs >10m, slot a follow-up deep-dive with relevant stakeholders.

End-of-doc: quick copy for Slack post (short):
"Weekly serving sync 35m // focus: cache-TTL experiment. Pre-reads: p95 charts + INF-4321. Please flag conflicts — meeting notes and action items will be posted after."
